response.sql:
WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  order_count,
  order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_total,
  order_count::numeric / NULLIF(AVG(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_to_scope_average
FROM scope_counts;

assumptions.assumption: The total and average are computed over scopes represented by at least one matched order; scopes with zero matched orders are not included because they have no rows in the matched data to group.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every account scope present in users, assigning zero orders to scopes with no matched orders; the average then includes those zero-count scopes.
alternatives.sql:
WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM users AS u
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  LEFT JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
  HAVING COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) > 0 OR COUNT(o.orderspivot) = 0
), matched_scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
), all_scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COALESCE(m.order_count, 0) AS order_count
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT acctscope FROM users) AS u
  LEFT JOIN matched_scope_counts AS m ON m.acctscope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  order_count,
  order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_total,
  order_count::numeric / NULLIF(AVG(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_to_scope_average
FROM all_scope_counts;
